summary: Software engineer with four years building and operating production backend infrastructure and data-platform systems end to end. I built a platform from zero to **$1M+ revenue** across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries** with **99.9% uptime**, owning data models, APIs, caching, and reliability at scale on AWS, Docker and CI/CD. I also ship AI systems on top of that stack, including agent-native workflows, and I like operating with high autonomy from architecture to production.
